scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. Eight boards from eight live games of 2026-11-08/09, each the run's events.jsonl cut at the turn's first state frame. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 13fb0fa011 with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with faith-strike-wipes-the-spreaders. On seven boards the on arm's orders add a war declaration and 2 or 3 CONDEMN_HERETIC orders, each after its soldier's walk where one is needed; the off arm's orders hold neither. The eighth (073552Z t55) is a control: six spreaders stood near our cities but too few could be reached, and the gene holds with orders unchanged.
